name: Claude (claude.ai)
siteVersion: 2026-09 anonymous app-shell capture (index-DviVWZR7, shared-{0-16}, shared-msg-{0-2}, shared-frame-*) — asset pins on assets-proxy.anthropic.com/claude-ai/v2/assets/v1/
description: Capability package for Anthropic's Claude chat at https://claude.ai. Sends prompts through the ProseMirror composer and reads streamed answers off the page. Real bundle analysis completed 2026-09-16 (22 bundles, ~4.2MB): conversation-scoped REST under /api/organizations/{org}/chat_conversations/{conv}/…, SSE (text/event-stream, resumable via resume_token, typed Ping/MessageStart/MessageDelta/MessageStop events), cookie auth over credentials:include with anthropic-version header. claude.ai itself is Cloudflare/hCaptcha gated — the DOM session must come from a headed live capture.
author: ui2api capabilities

capabilities.name: Chat stream
capabilities.description: Send a prompt on the claude.ai composer (ProseMirror, confirmed in bundles); streamed answer read off [data-testid="assistant-message"] nodes (confirmed in bundles shared-7/shared-msg-1). Wire takes the site's own send handler (src/profile/profile.ts built-in claude profile); raw send endpoint pending first live network log.
capabilities.method: ui-path (trusted input + Enter, site's own send handler)

permissions: session snapshot for claude.ai (cookie sessionKey per provider-catalog claude-web entry; Cloudflare + hCaptcha attestation require a headed capture)
Playwright over CDP — trusted input only, no synthetic events
network scoped to https://claude.ai/api (credentials:include, anthropic-version 2023-06-01) and assets-proxy.anthropic.com (public bundle CDN)

auth.regionNote: credential name from capabilities/provider-catalog.md claude-web entry (kind cookie, credentialName "sessionKey"); all app fetches run with credentials:include. Cookie set/expiry must be confirmed on live capture; CF challenge must be solved in the headed browser first.

transport.gate: Cloudflare (cli.ai returns a 'Just a moment…' JS challenge to plain curl) + hCaptcha invisible attestation (js.hcaptcha.com, __antClientAttestationHcaptchaInvisibleReady) + X-Device-Attestation header on streams
transport.appShell: public HTML at https://claude.ai embeds module manifest; JS bundles are public on assets-proxy.anthropic.com (not gated) — endpoint mining is scriptable, DOM/session is not
transport.streaming: SSE text/event-stream; resume_token param + sse_recovered; typed events Ping/MessageStart/MessageDelta/ContentBlock*/MessageStop/Error
transport.sendEndpoint: unverified for this build — classic POST …/chat_conversations/{conv}/completion absent from harnessed bundles; candidate …/chat_messages + …/task/{id}/status. Record from first live network log.

selectors.flags: extended_thinking (b-shared-0/b-shared-13), web_search (b-shared-0 et al.), artifacts/CCR sandbox

implementation.recommendation: drive the composer over trusted input (built-in profile), stream-read the assistant-message nodes; do not reconstruct the send wire until a live capture confirms it

builtinProfile: claude (src/profile/profile.ts lines 109-120) — package selectors mirror it; composer+answer selectors now bundle-grounded, send path still marked unverified until a package-owned live capture
analysisMethod: static bundle analysis: curl claude.ai (CF challenge) -> extracted app-shell module manifest from challenge HTML -> downloaded 22 bundles from assets-proxy.anthropic.com (~4.2MB) -> grepped for endpoints/streaming/auth/flags. No browser launched; DOM-selector and wire-send claims state confidence explicitly.
